title: ent-Pimarane diterpenoids from the aerial parts of Sigesbeckia pubescens and their myocardial protective activity

Eight new ent-pimarane diterpenoids (1–8), along with three known compounds (9–11), were isolated from the aerial parts of Sigesbeckia pubescens.
